body:
📦 **Senate `a9cab6f`** — fix(reading): retain comic selection after initialization

Fixes TASK-0402.

Keep the selected series by stable slug and synchronize the cached dropdown value when initialization changes its status label. Successful initialization now remains on the same series without showing a stale “not in list” value.

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---
